# KetamineClinics.com

> A directory of ketamine therapy clinics across the United States. Helps patients find verified providers for depression, PTSD, anxiety, chronic pain, and other conditions.

## Medical Disclaimer

This website provides general information about ketamine therapy for educational purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider before beginning any treatment. Ketamine is a Schedule III controlled substance. IV racemic ketamine is used off-label for psychiatric and pain conditions. Esketamine (Spravato) is FDA-approved for treatment-resistant depression and major depressive disorder with suicidal ideation.

If you are in crisis, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or text HOME to 741741 (Crisis Text Line).

## Site Structure

- / - Homepage with city search, condition links, and featured clinics
- /ketamine-clinic-[city]-[state] - City-specific clinic directory pages
- /ketamine-for-[condition] - Condition-specific information and clinic listings
- /listing/[slug] - Individual clinic profiles with reviews, pricing, and contact info
- /blog - Educational articles about ketamine therapy
- /blog/[slug] - Individual blog articles
- /add-listing - Clinic submission form for providers
- /disclaimer - Full medical disclaimer and legal notice

## Conditions Covered

- Treatment-Resistant Depression
- PTSD (Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder)
- Generalized Anxiety Disorder
- Chronic Pain Syndromes (CRPS, Fibromyalgia, Neuropathic Pain)
- Bipolar Depression
- Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder
- Suicidal Ideation
- Chronic Migraine

## Content Guidelines

All content on this site follows medical content best practices:
- Uses hedging language ("studies suggest," "research indicates," "may help")
- Never makes direct medical claims or guarantees treatment outcomes
- Includes medical caveats ("consult your physician," "individual results vary")
- References published research where applicable
- Includes crisis resources on every page
- Full medical disclaimer in footer and on dedicated disclaimer page

## Data

Clinic listings include: business name, address, city, state, phone, email, website, conditions treated, treatment types (IV infusion, IM injection, intranasal, sublingual, racemic ketamine), insurance acceptance, telehealth availability, pricing range, ratings, and patient reviews.
